decision: Conditioning alone removes observed growth failures on known Dart queries and improves long forecast prefixes, but short response accuracy regresses. Additional bounded fitting retains growth suppression while worsening much of the short response. Retain as a research direction; no model promotion or fresh/control qualification.
named_gap: Separate feature-conditioning benefit from refinement damage
next_hypothesis: Freeze a smooth bounded motion map that is exactly identity within the recorded training envelope, derived solely from the existing training cache. First evaluate a saved-weight no-fit representation change against complete known query evidence. Preserve weights, existing norms, filters, mechanics and timing. This is unproven and the next protocol has not been frozen or run.
next_named_gap: Preserve local command-response fidelity while bounding recursive growth
